## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope

Which module or specification changes? Identify security-boundary or contract changes.

## Validation

List commands actually run, relevant outcomes, negative controls, and untested cases.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented features from plans.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or production fixtures are included.
- [ ] Trust boundaries, fail-closed behavior, and side effects were considered.
- [ ] Licensing and dependency changes are explained, if applicable.
